Definition: to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to settle down, abide, dwell, tabernacle, reside; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to settle down to abide; 1a2) to abide, dwell, reside; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to make settle down, establish; 1b2) to make or cause to dwell; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to lay, place, set, establish, settle, fix; 1c2) to cause to dwell or abide
